messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-7892. Synthetic DNS probe (synthetic/dns/us-west-2) failing 6/10 checks in last 2m :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incident/INC-7892 — escalation to prod-sre (primary).
dario: acked INC-7892. Looking. :eyes: Any immediate customer pages?
alyssa: seeing a small uptick in 502s on the hosted-api edge in us-west-2 but not widespread. Telemetry shows DNS resolution latency spikes to 300ms for resolver pool x4.
kevin: loading canary dashboard — failures are DNS timeouts, not 5xx from model servers. Synthetic runner timeout is `2s` atm.
samira: can we bump probe timeout and re-run? Might be transient resolver slowness.
dario: good call. Temporarily bumping probe timeout to 8s for us-west-2. Applying: `kubectl patch cm synthetic-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"dns_probe_timeout":"8s"}}'`
ops-bot: configmap patch applied (commit c3f5b2a). Rerun queued probes.
dario: re-run shows failures dropping from 60% -> 12% in 30s.
alyssa: recommend silencing PD alerts for synthetic/dns/us-west-2 for 10m while we observe, to avoid alarm fatigue.
dario: silencing now for 10m.
pagerduty-bot: Alerts silenced for service synthetic-checks (10m) by dario.
kevin: parallel action: routing policy for canaries — switching small fraction (5%) of probe traffic to eu-west-1 to reduce noise and to validate cross-region health.
samira: also opened a ticket with infra-network: https://jira/redwood/INFRA-4521 — suspects resolver pool (10.2.3.0/24) experiencing short GC.
dario: customer impact summary: minor latency increase (median +25ms) for <2% of requests in us-west-2, no customer 5xx spike observed. Notifying GtM?
alyssa: pinging support and product ops to hold on escalations. Draft message: "No widespread customer impact; DNS probes noisy, mitigation in progress; will update in 30m."
kevin: mitigation checklist: 1) probe timeout bump (done) 2) probe reroute (done 5%) 3) infra-network investigating (ticket) 4) escalate to resolver vendor if persists 5) rollback to 2s after stable 10m window.
dario: assigning on-call handoff — I'll take first 20m, then handing to alyssa for monitoring window.
alyssa: oncall ack — will watch dashboards and push updates every 10m.
ops-bot: auto-note: INC-7892 annotated with actions: timeout-bump, canary-reroute, jira-INFRA-4521.
kevin: quick smoke test for anyone: `dig +time=5 @10.10.10.5 example.com` and `curl -svS https://hosted-api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/health` — share results.
samira: `dig` from a probe node returns SERVFAIL intermittently, looks like resolver restart logs around the same timestamps.
dario: reaching out to resolver on-call (network-oncall). @network-oncall — can you confirm any maintenance or incidents?
alyssa: network-oncall replied: "no scheduled maint, investigating. seeing a flurry of queries; autoscaler hit limits briefly."
dario: temporary mitigation plan: keep probe timeout=8s, keep 5% reroute to eu, increase resolver autoscaler min to 2x in affected pool, and monitor for 30m. If errors persist after 30m escalate to resolver vendor.
kevin: will prepare a short post-mortem template note in #incidents if we need to expand.
alyssa: update for slack: "Incident INC-7892: DNS probe flapping in us-west-2. Mitigations applied (timeout bump, partial reroute). Impact limited; monitoring. Next update in 15m."
dario: leaving final note: if we see sustained >20% canary failures or any customer 5xx spike, un-silence PD and page on-call network lead immediately.
alyssa: :thumbsup: locking thread for now, will post updates.
incident-bot: Thread marked resolved by silence expiry or manual close.
